intro: The needle on the seismograph has started drawing letters. The observatory has twelve hours before the mountain says whatever it is trying to say.
echo: When the mountain empties itself, the summit falls in and leaves a cauldron.

puzzles.title: Lahar
puzzles.flavor: Everything came out of the wash with a little something extra. Half a turn of the wheel and you'd have it.

partials.e583dcd2617dc7a2228ae8afea2e138bf002208c: You've decoded it, but it's not finished. One more layer.

hints: Each jumble is almost a word from this round, but with a letter to spare. Which letter, every time? And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

puzzles.title: Aftershock
puzzles.flavor: Up and down, up and down, and not a single space left.

blocks.text: IRSTA DHWUF NESEE HHVAY TERHS LYAAI NCEUE EFDAE ISFOC DHTNN OARON NWCIU UTEYL USHR

hints: All the right letters are here, just out of order. Could they have been written along a path that goes up and down?

puzzles.title: Pyroclastic
puzzles.flavor: Beeps, pauses and more beeps, from a payphone that should be disconnected.
hints: Two frequencies at once is the sound of a phone key being pressed. What letters did those keys carry?

puzzles.title: Aa
puzzles.flavor: Some squares have been given to you for free.
hints: The numbers describe runs of filled squares. What picture could they be drawing?

puzzles.title: Pahoehoe
puzzles.flavor: Only one page survived. It was the only page anyone needed.

blocks.text: The needle on the seismograph has started drawing letters. The observatory has twelve hours before the mountain says whatever it is trying to say.

hints: The first number in each pair never goes past the number of words on the page. What does the second count?

meta.title: Meta: Seismograph
hints: Every entry has two numbers. What in this round is numbered, and what could the second number count?
